config.label: Solana wallet address that receives USDC payments from tool callers (server operator's receiving wallet)
config.description: Solana wallet address that receives USDC payments from tool callers (server operator's receiving wallet). Required to accept x402 payments.

config.label: IBM Cloud API key used by the server to call watsonx
config.description: IBM Cloud API key used by the server to call watsonx.ai on behalf of end users. Create one at https://cloud.ibm.com/iam/apikeys.

config.label: watsonx
config.description: watsonx.ai project id scoping all inference calls. Find it under your project → Manage → General → Project ID. Provide this or WATSONX_SPACE_ID.

config.label: watsonx
config.description: watsonx.ai deployment space id. Alternative to WATSONX_PROJECT_ID.

config.label: Regional watsonx
config.description: Regional watsonx.ai inference host. Defaults to https://us-south.ml.cloud.ibm.com. Other regions: eu-de, eu-gb, jp-tok, au-syd, ca-tor.

config.label: Default chat/generation Granite model id
config.description: Default chat/generation Granite model id. Defaults to ibm/granite-3-8b-instruct.

config.label: Default embedding model id
config.description: Default embedding model id. Defaults to ibm/granite-embedding-278m-multilingual.

config.label: Solana account that sponsors transaction fees for x402 payments
config.description: Solana account that sponsors transaction fees for x402 payments. Defaults to the three.ws fee payer.

config.label: x402 facilitator endpoint for payment verification and settlement
config.description: x402 facilitator endpoint for payment verification and settlement. Defaults to https://facilitator.payai.network.
